item.title: Mansfield Woman Injured in Sunday Morning Accident
item.description: A 31-year-old Mansfield woman was injured in an accident on Highway 60 East of Norwood Sunday morning. The accident happened when the 2016 Hyundai Electra that she was driving left the roadway and struck a tree.
